name: @isnogudus/rail.js
description: Small workflow library: explicit, validated graphs of named steps. No dependencies, no persistence. Runs in modern Node and browsers.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && npx --yes esbuild rail.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/rail.js && npx --yes esbuild rail.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/rail.min.js
scripts.site:sync: rm -rf site/lib && mkdir -p site/lib && cp rail.js site/lib/rail.js && cp -r rail site/lib/rail && cp docs/rail-spec.md site/rail-spec.md
